To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
multinational companies can contribute to global poverty alleviation through the adoption of non-traditional, mostly non-Western, models of business involvement.
the BOP strategy is a new business model, which requires new capabilities and new values, and which is based on a different mindset.

global companies should adopt a new mindset in order to engage successfully in the BOP markets, that this mindset is based on the understanding that the BOP is not a new market but a different way of doing business, that global companies should focus on the development of the local economy and society and that the BOP should be viewed as the new growth frontier.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how multinational companies can develop a new business model to engage in poverty alleviation at the BOP.
the question of whether global companies can be part of the solution in the fight against global poverty.
how global companies can become involved in poverty alleviation and what the managerial challenges of global firms and global managers are in this context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the bottom of the pyramid represents an enormous business opportunity, but also a huge social challenge for multinational companies and global managers.

global companies have to be more than just a source of economic growth, and they have to become an integral part of the global social fabric, a force for social change, and a catalyst for social development.
the BOP is a complex and multifaceted challenge that requires a new mindset in global companies and global management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
global companies need to be involved in poverty alleviation through a strategic and mindset shift, and the development of new managerial capabilities.
the BOP is not only a market opportunity but a social responsibility for global companies.
BOP strategies require global companies to adopt a new mindset and new business models, which are not only focused on the bottom line but also on the bottom of the pyramid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
global firms can and should be involved in alleviating global poverty.
the BOP strategy is not a panacea for global poverty alleviation.
the BOP strategy is not a new strategy per se, but rather a new mindset and a new set of managerial capabilities that can be applied in any industry or country.
